text:
Harper Lee: Heads-up — PivotalCare needs a perf validation for a sales POC. Target: 3.5k sustained QPS for short patient summaries, with two 25s morning spikes at +180%. p95 goal <=200ms for ~130-token responses. They want a short run plan, p50/p95/p99, GPU sizing, and 1mo/6mo committed pricing by EOD tomorrow.

Diego Ramos: Quick clarifying Qs: is 3.5k QPS all generation? Any embeddings/rerank calls? And what model family?

Harper Lee: Buyer says ~90% generation, 7% embeddings, 3% long-form (600-800 tokens). Model: open-30B-deriv. They prefer Dedicated for predictable tails but want hosted numbers too.

Leah Park: Proposed test pattern: 12m ramp to 3.5k, 25m sustain, inject two 25s spikes at +180% (at ~8m and ~16m into sustain), then 5m cool down. Collect p50/p95/p99, error-rate, tokens/sec, token distribution, and GPU host metrics. Pin model hash and disable background warmups.

Leah Park: Example runner pseudo:
```
loadtest --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat --rate 3500 --duration 00:42:00 \
  --spikes "25s:+180%@8m,25s:+180%@16m" --body sample_prompts.json \
  --hdr "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" --out artifacts/pivotalcare-6123456789
```

Diego Ramos: Back-of-envelope tokens: avg ~130 tokens => 3.5k*130 = 455k tokens/s. With 30B FP16 and KV cache/ batching we estimate 3-4 A100-equivalent; 4-bit quant could reduce to 2-3. Long-form requests should be routed to a separate pool to avoid KV thrash. I'll run a quick sim tonight and post GPU-seconds + expected per-GPU throughput by 9:30am PT.

Harper Lee: Security asks: buyer listed CMK (not HSM) plus SIEM integration. SecEng, can you confirm hosted vs Dedicated answers?

SecEng: For CMK without HSM Dedicated supports CMK via our KMS proxy. HSM/BYOK requires Private and extra lead time. We can provide SOC2 report and log forwarding; ask buyer for syslog vs HTTPS endpoint. Drafting answers now.

Leah Park: Ops runbook items: reserve a staging Dedicated pool min=2 max=6, enable prefix KV cache, set autoscale aggressive for bursts, and route long-form to isolated nodes. Set alerts: p95>300ms or error-rate>0.5%.

perf-bot: scheduled run: pivotalcare-poc-6123458000 (runner perf-3).

Harper Lee: Pricing: procurement requested 1mo and 6mo committed options + hosted on-demand. Include burst credits and overage rates. Diego/Leah, can you provide GPU sizing and an ops rationale to attach?

Diego Ramos: On it. I'll post sim outputs and a concise GPU-sizing paragraph: steady-state GPUs, expected autoscale headroom for bursts, and recommendation (Dedicated + split routes) before 9:30am.

Leah Park: I'll reserve the pool on stage and prepare the runbook + short "why Dedicated helps" blurb for the quote.

Harper Lee: I'll schedule a 30m sync with PivotalCare for tomorrow 8:45am PT and include SecEng and Ops. Attaching sample prompts and questionnaire in the invite.

Diego Ramos: No blockers, starting the sim now.

perf-bot: run started pivotalcare-poc-6123458000 (ETA ~28m).

Harper Lee: Thanks team — we'll reconvene after Diego posts results.
